bands.condition: 1001-2000 sqm, OR building ridge height up to 7.6 m
Above 2001 sqm, OR ridge height above 7.6 m up to 9.0 m
Building of any height with rack storage

notes: Pump pressure figures in this table are minimums; must be supported by hydraulic calculations.

Table applies only to storage on ground, not exceeding 3.7 m (12 ft), excluding tyre storage: packaging materials (with/without pallets), raw materials (solid pile/shelves/pallets), finished goods (solid pile/shelves/pallets), miscellaneous storage in/around manufacturing/assembly/packaging areas, retail storage on shelves (other than catwalk storage). Must also comply with supplementary protection for hazard/critical rooms per Table 9/10/11.

For rack storage with plastic/combustible packaging, water-reactive solids/liquids, lithium battery storage, ignitable chemical storage, retail catwalk storage, or oxidizing agent storage: follow relevant Indian Standards; pumping capacity/water storage must be justified by hydraulic calculation, not read off this table directly.
If cluster exceeds 5 buildings, another equivalent pump/storage set required (max 2 sets recommended).
